content.title: Rule Acquisition | A Flat Course Escalates into 3D
content.summary: Establish an outsider on a readable flat route, prove two base rules, then use one visible capability pickup to change how it moves. Return to a readable final approach before the same route extrudes into 3D, preserving identity, direction, and destination through the finish.

quick_start.input_format: Foreign subject + planar rule route + two different basic rule proofs + one visible ability trigger + functional new movement method + return to readable end segment + same route dimension upgrade + readable end point
quick_start.recommended_input: 15 seconds, 16:9. The amber glass catalog mark enters the flat archive index, waits for the scanning bar to pass, and then turns the mirror to unlock the light gate; it only touches the purple phase seal once, becomes translucent and passes through the opaque partition, and then returns to the same white light path. Nearing the end the index plane rises into a three-dimensional archival atrium, and the mark maintains its direction into the white return slot and remains stable.
required_anchors: Establish one outsider, one flat rule-bound route and one stable destination direction before any upgrade.
Show the outsider successfully using at least two different base route rules before capability acquisition.
Use the acquired capability to enter a different movement mode while keeping identity and destination continuous.
Return from the upgraded movement to one readable final approach, then extrude the established route near the finish and end at one goal without resetting direction.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish an outsider on a readable flat route, prove two base rules, then use one visible capability pickup to change how it moves. Return to a readable final approach before the same route extrudes into 3D, preserving identity, direction, and destination through the finish.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Introduce one visually distinct outsider into a rule-bound flat route and establish one stable travel direction. Let the outsider first demonstrate the route's base grammar through movement, avoidance or collection, then acquire exactly one visible capability through physical contact with a clearly presented trigger. Use that capability to enter a genuinely different travel mode while preserving identity and destination. Near the finish, extrude the already-established route into a deeper spatial regime without resetting direction or objective, and hold the outsider at a readable goal so both rule learning and dimensional escalation can be verified.

invariants.rule: Establish one outsider, one flat rule-bound route and one stable destination direction before any upgrade.
invariants.purpose: Creates a baseline for both rule learning and later spatial escalation.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting after the upgrade removes proof that the subject learned or changed.

invariants.rule: Show the outsider successfully using at least two different base route rules before capability acquisition.
invariants.purpose: Proves participation in the world rather than decorative compositing.
invariants.ablation_failure: An immediate capability change makes the earlier route irrelevant.

invariants.rule: Bind exactly one capability change to visible contact with a presented trigger.
invariants.purpose: Makes the upgrade causal and auditable.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unexplained morph reads as a disconnected effect.

invariants.rule: Use the acquired capability to enter a different movement mode while keeping identity and destination continuous.
invariants.purpose: Turns the upgrade into functional progression.
invariants.ablation_failure: A cosmetic change without new movement does not escalate the route.

invariants.rule: Return from the upgraded movement to one readable final approach, then extrude the established route near the finish and end at one goal without resetting direction.
invariants.purpose: Provides a visible handoff into the world-scale payoff while preserving route continuity.
invariants.ablation_failure: A cut from the upgraded movement to an unrelated 3D finish would hide the route handoff.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: Nintendo and Mario names, logos, HUD text and website marks
the source Super Mario-style blue-sky brick platform level and native enemies
the source coin rows, question blocks, mushroom power-up, cloud ride and flagpole goal
the source yellow bull character, body inflation gag and exact celebratory pose
the source exact obstacle order, camera conversion and copyrighted game composition

instantiations.concept: In an original projected archive index, an amber glass catalog token moves across a flat graphite map. It waits for a scanning bar to clear and rotates its mirrored face to redirect a locked light gate, proving two different local rules. Contact with one violet phase seal turns the token translucent, letting it pass through opaque index dividers without leaving the route. It returns to the illuminated baseline; near the destination the map rises into a three-dimensional archive atrium and the same token enters a white return slot.

instantiations.concept: In a tactile clay irrigation plan, a mechanical seed pod rolls only along damp blue channels, pauses for a rotating sluice arm and bridges one dry break with a ribbon of wet clay. One copper heat stamp deploys short digging vanes, enabling the pod to tunnel beneath a wide unwatered zone rather than moving above it. It resurfaces on the same route; the flat plan then lifts into terraced greenhouse beds and the pod enters a single watering cradle.
